meta.title: Glycerol/water Newtonian glide forces from Allmendinger 2014 (figure-digitized)
meta.force_source: Fig. 3(A) / thesis Fig. 3.3(A) plot digitization of mean glide force symbols; F_fluid = F_glide - F_friction(Table 1)
meta.digitization_uncertainty: Approximate visual reading of published figure axes (viscosity 0-50 mPa s, force 0-300 N); estimated ~5-15% absolute force uncertainty especially at low force. Not author SI tables.
meta.protocol_note: Rows are literature-derived with explicit digitization caveats. Report status is experimental_comparison only; does NOT alone justify independently_validated.

excluded_sources.zhang2018.pdf: HPMC/PEO polymeric solutions (non-Newtonian); total work J not fluid-only force
excluded_sources.verwulgen2018.pdf: Geometry+friction tabulated; absolute glycerol F_exp-F_fric only in figures (already covered by setup JSON)
